outcome: Make every production report state the real next step
owner_impact: Success emails can no longer say that nothing remains when an approved epic already has a known next ticket. Each deployed ticket must now report either the next ticket in plain language or that the approved scope is finished.

next.text: This workflow/reporting update is complete. The Lab remains live at https://eliseofe.github.io/virtual-lab/ and future ticket-completion reports will use the new two-outcome Next rule.

technical_evidence: Success reporting requires terminal-report v2 and rejects missing, stale or invalid report data instead of falling back.
Merge commits detect the candidate-specific report by comparing the deployed commit with its first parent.
